name: FinPay Observability Dashboard
description: Dashboard de observabilidad del Lakeflow Pipeline FinPay.

datasets.name: processed_records_by_layer
datasets.query: SELECT event_date, layer, SUM(processed_records) AS processed_records FROM fintech_finpay_dev.observability.v_processed_records_by_layer GROUP BY event_date, layer ORDER BY event_date, layer

datasets.name: rejected_records
datasets.query: SELECT event_date, layer, source_name, rejection_reason, SUM(rejected_records) AS rejected_records FROM fintech_finpay_dev.observability.v_rejected_records GROUP BY event_date, layer, source_name, rejection_reason ORDER BY event_date, layer, source_name

datasets.name: rejection_rate_by_layer
datasets.query: SELECT event_date, layer, processed_records, rejected_records, rejection_rate FROM fintech_finpay_dev.observability.v_rejection_rate_by_layer ORDER BY event_date, layer

datasets.name: flow_progress
datasets.query: SELECT event_date, layer, flow_name, flow_status, input_records, processed_records FROM fintech_finpay_dev.observability.v_processed_records_by_layer ORDER BY event_date, layer, flow_name
